subject: design/argus-artifacts
statement: `docs/problems/<slug>/problem.md` holds: a closed header of intake-time facts only (slug · principal identity · authority-contract version at intake · optional per-problem envelope override — **no mutable cell**: status lives on the delivery side, where the derived block owns it), the **Idea** section (the human's words, verbatim, never edited), and the **`A-n` family** — one dense, append-only sequence of human authority entries: pre-rulings recorded at intake, then every breaking-call answer as it arrives, each entry dated, attributed to its human author, carrying the authority-contract version current at recording, and (for answers) citing the brief it answers (`delivery:<slug>#E-k`). An `A-n` binds as a ruling-in-advance for everything downstream; the file is append-only forever with no exceptions — DINV-1 is absolute. The slug is kebab-case, minted at intake from the idea; a collision appends `-2`, `-3`.
